description: This file defines a PHP function 'additionalDetailsNote' used for generating additional details for notes within SuiteCRM, a CRM platform. It constructs an informational string based on provided fields, primarily focusing on the note's team name and description, and returns an array containing related display information and links.

methods.name: additionalDetailsNote
methods.description: Generates additional display info for a note, including team name, a truncated description, and links to view/edit the note.
